en:
It's January.
Player contracts are renewed every
January.

We'll discuss extending contracts of
players whose terms expired last year,
plus their salary and length.
Beginning this year's renewals.

No one is due a new contract this
year, it seems. That ends the
renewals.

The brightly lit players are up for
renewal. How shall we handle it?

#sname#, you negotiate in person
and set the terms directly.

I'll negotiate with everyone and renew
all deals amicably, but don't expect
great terms.

Select players who won't be renewed.
They'll be automatically transferred.

Ending renewals. Unrenewed players
will be transferred out of the club,
so be careful.

Select a player to negotiate
a renewal with.

By my estimate, all the unrenewed
players will cost @P/%m@ in
total. Is that all right?

Select the players you won't renew.
There's no going back once chosen,
so be careful.

Renewals are done. The total cost
this time was @P/%m@.

Ending renewals. Anyone not yet renewed
will be transferred automatically.
Is that all right?

Your club seems short of funds.
Please set the amount again.
Now enter this player's salary.

That's far from what the player had in
mind. You'll need to offer more
to win them over.

They're very unhappy with the money,
and it shows in their tone. Their
pride is badly hurt.

You and the player are far apart. They
seem quite unhappy. A big increase
will probably be needed.

They don't look happy. A little upset
about the money. Perhaps offer a
bit more.

The talks aren't clicking. Their pride
won't allow this amount. They seem
a little unhappy.

They don't seem happy with the amount.
Their unhappiness shows on their face.
Let's reconsider the amount slightly.

There's some unhappiness, though only
slight. Talks still aren't clicking.
Let's consider offering a little more.

Their expression has clouded a little.
The amount seems slightly off from
what they were hoping for.

A slightly tense look. There's a subtle
mismatch over the money. The offer is
just a touch too low, it seems.

Sadly, the deal with @Y/#tk00#@ fell
through. Can't be helped at this
amount...

From July, half a year is added.
%d-year contract: @Y/%m@ in

#sname#, you're short of money.
Please enter it again.

Each new year, the coach reviews the
positions of everyone in the squad.
Changes reflect last year's results.

The coach will suggest position
changes for some players. Change
them if you wish.

Let's go through the position changes.
The coach will explain who is being
considered and why.

Goalkeeper.
Needs strong one-on-ones, instinct and
judgement, plus nerve for penalties.

Defender.
Needs good interceptions and tackling
to shut down the opposition's attacks.

Midfielder.
Needs a playmaker's range and vision,
plus retention, passing, versatility.

Forward.
Needs kicking power and shot accuracy
to reliably turn chances into goals.

Whose position shall we change?
Please select a player.

Which position for them?
Please choose.

That finishes this year's
position changes. All right?

That concludes the position changes.
Players stay registered in these
positions until next year.

No players need a position change
this year, it seems. That concludes
the position changes.

I don't think this amount is
reasonable.

Is this figure a mistake? Or
are you taking the mickey?

So... that's all I'm worth
to you, is it?

Not much of a joke. Too stupid to
even get angry about.

Is this amount how you rate me?
That's too harsh.

Think I'll accept this amount?
If you don't want me, say so.
...Stop joking.

Hey, come on! Even I get angry.
This is no joke!

I can't accept this amount. I did
more for this club than that.

I believe my value is somewhat
higher than this.

Please reconsider the money.
I can't accept this.

I can't accept that amount.
I'm worth more than that, surely.

That's far from my expectation.
I can't accept that amount.

I'm worth a bit more than that,
no? Please understand.
...Still low.

Could you raise it a bit?
My livelihood's at stake.

Could you give a bit more
on the money?

Hmm, we're almost there.
Could you raise the sum a bit?

Just a little more, please?
Could you go higher?

We're just one step apart
from my figure.

We're nearly there. Could you
raise the salary a bit?

Almost there, but the amount...
Raise it a bit?
...Nearly there.

Just a bit more! Please? Then
I'll sign on the dotted line!

You rate me this highly? Wow!
I'm so happy.

I'm honoured you rate me so
highly. Thanks. Let's sign.

R-really? You value me this much?
It's like a dream.

Leave it to me. A year to
remember, I promise.

I never expected such high
hopes of me.

Rating me that highly, eh?
Now that's good to hear.
Thanks. I'll sign.

T-this isn't a dream, is it?
Feels unreal...

I'll work hard to live up
to your hopes.

To the future.
I'll give my all.

Quite high... I'm surprised.
Let me sign.

Nice valuation.
Back with you, then.

Very good terms.
I'd better give it my all, then.

You've splashed out!
I'll do it, then.
Good terms.

Wow, you went all out.
I'd better pull my weight too.

That's right on the limit. Oh
well, I suppose that's fine.

The bare minimum, really. Still,
I promise to give my all.

That's exactly my asking figure.
Almost suspiciously on target.

You're stingy.
You win. Let's sign.

That's the lowest I can accept.
All right, I'll sign.

I'd really like a bit more...
All right, I'll sign.

A bit too calculated.
...Fine, I'll accept.

Exactly what I asked for.
Well, why not. I'll sign.
This time I'd like a %d-year deal.

Hmm,
I'd like a %d-year deal.

I'd like a %d-year contract,
if possible...
Let's make it %d years.

I'd like a %d-year
contract, please.
%d years feels right.
Request %d years

Hmm, I feel like a
%d-year deal this time.

A promising start
to the talks.

Good, that's the right answer.
I expect excellent negotiations.

What a relief...
Let's keep this up.

Yes! Going well.
Let's keep rolling.
I'm glad you accepted that.

Glad to hear it.
Do the contract like this too.
...A relief.

Yes! Brilliant.
Good feeling about this.

So my opinion won't be accepted,
is that it?

So my opinion doesn't matter
at all?

I guess my opinion never
counts for much.

Why did you even bother asking
me about the length, then?
My opinion is just ignored, then.

Ignoring my opinion?
Not a good sign.
...Unpleasant.

You're joking. I went to the
trouble of giving you my opinion.

We can't seem to agree.
Sadly, talks have broken down.

There's no point going on.
Goodbye.

Even I can't put up with
this any longer.

Talks are off.
We won't meet again.
This is a waste of time now.

Can't take this.
I'm going home.
...Pointless now.

No point going on.
See ya.

You won't be signing %s for
next season. Is that all right?
@Y/%s@ has been transferred.

Dropped this quickly? What a
fine club you run.

What exactly is lacking in me?
You'll regret this.

Can this club really afford to
let a player of my level go?

Even I can't beat old age.
Perhaps it's a fair offer.

My best is still to come.
Won't you reconsider?

What do you dislike about me?
Disappointing.

My experience would surely have
been useful to the club.

Thank you for everything so far.
I'll take life easy from now on.

Written off so young?
I feel rather betrayed.

Pushing me out at my age?
What's your complaint?

What did I do wrong?
Please tell me!

I'd rather my fans didn't see
me in decline.

Giving up on me at this age...
Can you see the future?

Please, calm down a little.
I'll work even harder.

My experience counts right now.
Give me a little longer?

Thanks for everything so far.
I'm grateful to the club.

This decision humiliates me.
You'll pay a painful price.

Sack me if you must.
There are endless places to go.

Wasting my experience is
a foolish decision.

An old soldier simply moves on.
Thanks for everything. Loved it.

As a joke, it's most unpleasant.
Even I get angry sometimes.

I'm to accept this decision?
Ridiculous.

Your decision is wrong.
You're going to regret it.

Hm, the time has finally come.
A wonderful club it was.

Go ahead and try. There are clubs
beyond count that want my talent.

Nothing is worse than ignorance.
I'm talking about you.

Surely the most important quality
in a player is experience?

Was I of any use?
Thanks for looking after me.

This joke has gone too far.
Deeply offensive!

It'll be too late for regrets.
And I'm at my peak right now.

The most foolish decision of my
career. Everyone will mock you.

Know when to step away.
Thanks for it all.

Wh-what do you know about me?
This is all wrong.

You understand nothing.
You don't know the real me!

This is absurd.
You'll definitely regret it!

I've got unfinished business.
Use me a bit longer.

Know what I'm capable of?
I'm only getting better!

Please calm down a bit.
You're being fooled.

Few players have this
much experience!

Age counts against me, but used
well I can still deliver.

Tell me what's lacking.
I'll sort it out, I promise...

This is my prime, you know?
Do you really have no use for me?

So you need others more than
my experience... It hurts.

I can still do it. Look, my body
still moves just fine!

I thought this was a club I'd
happily give my whole life to...

Nobody can beat me for drive.
So please, I'm asking you.

What's the problem? My youth?
My talent? I...

My body may be near its limit,
but my spirit beats the rookies!

Anyone blind to talent's a fool.
I did nothing wrong.

I thought you a fool before, but
not this much.

Fine. Clubs all over the world
will buy my experience.

I can still beat the young lads.
My experience pays off now.

That is lack of foresight.
What do you know about me?

Glad you're throwing me out.
No more putting up with you.

I can picture you fuming as I
shine at another club.

I've got plenty of stamina and
spirit. I can play on for ages.

Think it over again, will you?
Who else can you rely on?

What are you thinking...?
This is ridiculous.

You can't buy experience.
You'll regret this.

I can fight for ten more years.
I must still have the ability.

Hang on, you've got this wrong.
Others should go before me.

What a colossal misjudgement.
What do you gain from sacking me?

What? You don't want me?
Must be a mistake.

Sometimes experience beats youth.
Think again.

My real ability shows from here.
Do you realise?

Transfer me now and I'll come
back as your worst enemy.

Mental ability from experience
should matter to the club.

I've worried about my form
lately too.

What exactly am I lacking?
I simply can't accept this.

Wait, please.
I haven't been told anything.

Springing this on me,
I'm not mentally prepared.

Maybe it's about time I stepped
aside. Thanks for everything.

I can't accept that.
Just as things start going well!

This is my peak right now!
Do you realise that?

No one here is better than me.
This has to be a mistake.

Stepping aside matters, but
I want the contract kept.

Even if you transfer me now, you
won't gain anything from it.

Am I such a nuisance?
Supporters won't stay quiet.

Is there something you need more
than my experience?

I suppose it's about time.
Thanks for looking after me.

You're heartless.
Nobody will follow you like this.

My ability's below squad level?
Are you blind or what?

I can still beat those kids.
But you don't want me anyway.

I don't need a send-off.
I'll go by myself.

What did you want from me? Just
a tool for your vanity?

Get rid of me now and you could
regret it forever.

Cross a veteran and you'll pay.
I'm not here just for show.

Maybe it's time to call it a day.
I've been feeling my limits.

Transferring me at my age? What
did you expect?

Just as my best is coming,
you throw it away. Shame.

No complaints. I doubt anything I
said would reach you.

It's a shame to leave midway, but
I had a pretty good time.

Terrible.
You don't understand me.
To you, are players just tools?

Veterans have their own quality.
If you can't see it, so be it.

Lousy food, but I ate my fill.
See ya.

Unbelievable...
I'm speechless.

Hopeless club.
The worst.

Then I'll quit this club
myself.

Given my age it's natural, but
it's a shame to go mid-season.

There's no hope in this world,
is there...

You won't hear me out? How
impressive.

What a terrible thing to do.
You've no idea how people feel.

Nobody knows me better than I do.
I've still got more to give.

You've got to be joking.
This is a betrayal.

...That's not what we agreed.
Hold on.

Experience beats everything else.
Please reconsider.

If possible, could you wait until
the season ends?

You can judge a player this old?
Impressive.

This is my growth period.
Don't you think it'd be a waste?

Can't you wait till I'm out of
contract? You're impatient.

A fun club.
Thanks for the memories.

You're joking.
What do you know about me?

Come on, for real!
I'll never forgive you for this.

No other player has this much
experience. Are you sure?

Bad timing, but whatever.
Thanks for everything.

Didn't you want me for my talent?
I'm only starting to grow!

Hey, wait,
this isn't what we agreed.

Transfer me? Really?
Don't do it.

Transfer me now?
You've got to be joking.

If I upset you, I'm sorry.
Can you call this off?

La la la, can't hear you.
I heard nothing, okay?

You promised me, didn't you?
This isn't fair.

I'm about to retire, you know.
Can't you wait a bit?

Hey, are you serious?
This isn't funny.

Cruel joke, come on.
It's not April 1st.

Transfer ME? You've got nerve.
You'll regret it!

Give me one more month.
I'll deliver, honest.

Is this any way to treat someone
just for being injured?

Have you no humanity at all?
You disgust me.

You'd treat me like this...?
Too cruel.

After working me to the bone?
You're despicable.

Don't be absurd. Whose fault is
it that I got injured?

Heh, a handy opportunity, is it?
Suits a coward like you.

Treating the injured so.
Unbelievable.

Fiend, devil, monster!
Go to hell!

This injury will heal in no time.
Can't you wait for that?

Injuries come with the job.
You'll pay dearly for this.

My body will heal, but the wound
to my heart...

Are you sane?
Look after injured players!

My injury will heal soon.
And yet you'd transfer me?

I know what you think.
I was in your way, wasn't I?
I'll resent this.

Injury's just an excuse, right?
You dislike me?

Please wait a little longer.
I'll recover soon.

It'll clear up soon.
Please reconsider.

Is my injury the reason
for this transfer?

Transferring me over an injury?
You're heartless.

This is out of the question.
Please reconsider.

You'd transfer an injured player?
Are you even human?

This is what heartless means.
Monstrous.

My fortune says moving me this
week is bad luck.

My injury's just your chance?
If I'm in the way, say so.

Injury won't change my ability.
Please reconsider.

If you sell me now, my injury
may never heal.

Kicking me while I'm down?
What are you thinking?

Transferring me because I'm hurt?
That's not decent.

Did you plan this injury just
to push me out?
No place for the injured?

What a club!
Drop dead!
